title: Ramlila Maidan: The ground where protests dealt blows to Congress, twice
content: The other two designated venues are Burari Ground in north Delhi and CBD Ground in east Delhi. The move comes amid protests against the Election Commission over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. While Jantar Mantar's removal marks a significant shift in the capital's protest landscape, Ramlila Maidan brings its own political history to the fore.

title: 'Can't beat us, threaten us': Rahul thanks protesters after INDIA bloc march to SC
content: Rahul Gandhi thanked supporters for gathering in Delhi during the INDIA bloc march, aimed at raising awareness about electoral issues. The protest focused on alleged discrepancies and the Election Commission’s handling of voter deletions. Despite police barricades disrupting the march, Gandhi and fellow leaders moved forward by petitioning the Supreme Court for disclosure of Election Commission documents and measures to prevent unannounced voter deletions.

title: Jeff Bezos to Americans: Don’t support politicians who blame; they lack solutions
content: Jeff Bezos emphasizes the importance of finding solutions rather than blaming others, particularly in politics. He identifies rising housing costs as a genuine concern for many Americans and suggests effective policies to alleviate this issue. Bezos argues that increasing demand without matching supply can exacerbate affordability problems. He highlights Austin's successful housing initiatives as a positive example to consider.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo reveals he translated English for Messi at award ceremonies
content: Cristiano Ronaldo has opened up about his 15-year rivalry with Lionel Messi, revealing how he helped the Argentine understand English during award ceremonies. The Al-Nassr star described their relationship as respectful and their competition as healthy, comparing it to Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost. However, Ronaldo remains firm in his belief that his remarkable goalscoring record makes him football’s greatest ever.

title: He gave land given for road, sold TDRs for Rs 6.02 crore; ITAT taxes capital gains
content: The landowner chose to sell the TDRs he had received for surrendering 2,839 square metres of land. He sold them to a builder for Rs 6 crore but did not pay income tax on the proceeds. His understanding was that the amount received from the sale was a capital receipt and was therefore not taxable.

title: Kerala crash: Old video shows accused teen’s Mini Cooper speeding at 220kmph
content: Suhail Sajeev, a 19-year-old, was arrested after a crash in Nedumbassery that killed three people. The victims were returning home on a scooter when a Mini Cooper struck them from behind. Sajeev's Instagram video showed reckless driving, with a speedometer reaching 220kmph prior to the incident. Police suspect he was intoxicated during the accident, with ongoing investigations. Further inquiries into alcohol service by local bars are also being conducted.

title: Washington couple says utility threatened power cut unless they signed easement
content: Liz Covert and Denis Goudie are taking a stand against the Orcas Power and Light Cooperative’s recent installation of a steel tower on their property. They claim that the easement permits only minor landscaping and not major installations. Furthermore, they contend that they received no prior notification regarding the construction set in motion in 2023.

title: Taylor Swift’s $4m Nashville education centre now showcases local student art
content: In 2012, Taylor Swift donated $4 million to create an education center at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. This center focuses on engaging children and families with the history of country music. Currently, it hosts an exhibition called Connection featuring works by students and artists from Friends Life Community. Participants learn letterpress printing techniques and create their own unique posters.

title: Michael Dell, Intel co-founder Gordon Moore’s funds among 8 largest university gifts
content: Ken Griffin just made a huge splash in the world of philanthropy by donating a whopping $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University! This massive gift includes $2 billion for a cutting-edge campus in Miami and $1 billion for the prestigious School of Computer Science in Pittsburgh.

title: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively’s $500,000 gift trains Indigenous water operators
content: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively's generous contribution to Water First has empowered Indigenous communities by enhancing their water management capabilities. After an intensive 15-month certification process, eight Indigenous trainees have successfully graduated, accumulating over 2,000 hours of combined practical and technical training. These graduates are set to embark on careers in water treatment, fostering self-sufficiency within their communities and showcasing a steadfast dedication to sustainable water management.

title: SBI Research recommends LTCG on equities to be scrapped; calls for DTAA clarity
content: The proposal is aimed at making foreign capital flows into equities more stable and limiting the chances of abrupt withdrawals that could put pressure on the rupee. Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) currently face a 12.5% LTCG tax on equity investments. The Union Budget 2026 retained this rate for listed shares and equity mutual funds, continuing the tax framework introduced as part of a major fiscal overhaul in 2024.

title: Connor McDavid’s mother Kelly: How did she support his hockey dreams?
content: In her journey as a devoted mother, Kelly McDavid articulated the significant sacrifices made for her sons, Connor and Cameron, in their pursuit of competitive hockey. Balancing their education and well-being with rigorous training sessions created a challenge. While Connor exhibited remarkable determination, his tendency to pressure himself raised concerns for Kelly, especially when fatigue set in.

title: GTA 6 Lucia leak: What did Cyberleek reveal about the new leak roadmap?
content: Exciting new clips from Cyberleek regarding GTA 6 have ignited discussions among gamers, particularly concerning explicit depictions of the protagonists, which raises questions about nudity in the highly anticipated game. Additionally, a strategic roadmap for future leaks tied to CYBERLEEK coin market cap milestones has been proposed. At a hefty 200 GB, the game promises to be extensive.

title: Bank cut Rs 5.89 crore FD rate from 7.75% to 3.5%; Court orders higher interest
content: Initially, the FD earned interest at rates of 7.75%, 8.25% and 7.75% over different periods. However, from January 30, 2018, the bank lowered the rate to 3.5%. Challenging the reduction, the deposit holder approached the court again, arguing that the bank had cut the interest rate without any valid reason or justification.

title: 'Disclose EC files, set up audit panel': Key points from INDIA bloc's plea in SC
content: A march led by Rahul Gandhi and other opposition leaders reached the Supreme Court to contest electoral irregularities. The leaders filed a joint petition naming the Election Commission of India as a respondent. This petition challenges decisions related to the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. The opposition demands transparency and safeguards against voter deletions during the process.

title: Mohanlal praises Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion': 'I am truly impressed'
content: After viewing 'Drishyam: The Conclusion', Mohanlal has lauded its fresh narrative, which sets it apart from the Malayalam versions. Starring Ajay Devgn as the cunning Vijay Salgaonkar, the film showcases his brilliant tactics against law enforcement. Impressively, it has grossed over Rs 479.80 crore worldwide since launch, with Jaideep Ahlawat's role introducing compelling new dynamics into the gripping plot.

title: Alexander Zverev crowned year-end world No. 1 after Alcaraz's shock Shanghai Masters defeat
content: Alexander Zverev has made history by clinching the year-end world No. 1 ranking for the very first time. His remarkable journey to the top was amplified by Carlos Alcaraz's surprising defeat at the Shanghai Masters. Zverev's stellar season includes his inaugural Grand Slam triumphs at both the French Open and US Open.

title: IIT students flag uneven faculty support amid academic pressure and mental health concerns
content: IIT students report mixed experiences with faculty support, with some professors offering help while others respond insensitively. There is a prevailing culture of academic pressure that impacts students' mental health and performance. Many students feel isolated and overwhelmed in a competitive environment filled with equally accomplished peers. Counselling services exist, but there's a need for more awareness of psychological issues among faculty.

title: Suspected IED explodes in J&K's Poonch; security heightened
content: An explosion was reported in the Satwal-Naki area near the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir. Security measures were heightened as officials assessed the situation following the blast. It remains unclear whether the individuals involved were terrorists or Pakistani security personnel. Indian Army troops detected and destroyed two rusted landmines during ongoing operations in the Mendhar sector.

title: 23 days without food, then a sprint through heart of Delhi: Meet Neha Bora
content: A soldier’s daughter from Uttarakhand’s Khatima, a theatre scholar at JNU, and president of AISA, Neha Bora was detained after a dramatic dash through central Delhi towards Connaught Place. Weeks after a 23-day fast, she is back on the streets, with Jantar Mantar no longer a protest venue. Here is how a stage actor became the face of a student agitation.

title: Hezbollah-linked device explodes in student's bag during Israel school trip, 1 killed
content: An explosive device in a student's bag detonated during a school trip in northern Israel. This incident resulted in one death and 24 injuries, including students and staff. The IDF identified the device as Hezbollah cluster munition that had landed previously. Emergency services were dispatched to assist the affected individuals and manage the situation. The Israeli police urged the public to keep distance and report any suspicious items.

title: Malaysia Airlines offloads passengers after oxygen snag delay, arranges alternatives
content: While half the passengers were not allowed to board the flight citing a technical glitch, the flight later departed at 2.20am with 100 passengers, though the flight was originally scheduled to depart at 11.55pm on Sunday.

title: Rishabh Pant ruled out of first two India A matches against New Zealand A
content: Due to an unfortunate injury obtained in the Irani Cup, Rishabh Pant will miss the first two matches of India's tour to New Zealand. Kumar Kushagra has stepped in as his substitute. Starting October 24, India will engage in three multi-day matches against New Zealand A. Captain Dhruv Jurel will helm the squad, filled with experienced talent.

title: Kansas couple’s $550,000 wedding venue dispute revived by appeals court
content: A Kansas couple who planned to build a wedding venue sought more than $550,000 in damages after a two-year construction delay and changes to local building rules led to a dispute over sprinkler requirements. The Kansas Court of Appeals has now revived their equal protection claim against Leavenworth County while upholding the dismissal of their other claims.

title: YouTube star’s Utah estate with transforming indoor pool lists for $13.95m
content: Kris Krohn has listed his expansive mansion in Utah for $13.95 million. This sprawling estate features a unique hydraulic indoor pool that transforms into a ballroom. The property also includes a commercial-grade gym, spa facilities, and an extensive garage for car collections. The mansion is designed for full-time living and hosting large events. It is expected to attract entrepreneurs and high-level professionals looking for a versatile space.

title: $900,000 expedition heads to Nikumaroro to test Amelia Earhart theory
content: A group of adept marine archaeologists is gearing up for an intriguing exploration in the lagoon at Nikumaroro Island. This five-day expedition aims to uncover whether a mysterious object discovered there is linked to Amelia Earhart's vanished aircraft. With an array of modern equipment at their disposal, they hope to shed light on decades of speculation surrounding her disappearance and the island's enigmatic connection to her fate.

title: Congress chief Kharge dons Batman mask during march to SC
content: Opposition stalwarts, along with hundreds of supporters and activists, undertook their "March for Democracy" to the Supreme Court on Monday on a heavily barricaded route and filed a joint petition against SIR and alleged poll irregularities, in another show of strength after a series of street protests over the "vote chori" charge.

title: Cleveland church where Martin Luther King Jr preached gets $750,000 grant
content: Shiloh Baptist Church in Cleveland has secured a $750,000 grant to enhance its historic building. The funding aims to improve accessibility and support ongoing community services. Planned repairs include restoring the portico and addressing water damage throughout the church. This grant connects the church's rich history in civil rights activism to its future role in the community. The church aims to remain a vibrant space for worship and community engagement.

title: How Jantar Mantar became Delhi's designated protest site and what changes now
content: Jantar Mantar is no longer Delhi's designated protest site. Three new venues identified for demonstrations. But how did an 18th-century observatory become the capital's most recognisable protest address? From farmers' rallies at Boat Club to Anna Hazare's anti-corruption movement and the wrestlers' protests, here's how Delhi's protest grounds evolved over the decades and what changes now.

title: Jason Mraz turned old San Diego avocado grove into 17-acre regenerative farm
content: In 2004, Jason Mraz purchased an avocado grove near San Diego, which he transformed into Mraz Family Farms. Now known for its organic avocados, California-crafted coffee, and seasonal crops, the farm emphasizes regenerative agriculture for enhanced soil health and resilience. Products are supplied to local eateries and shops, and available online, adhering to seasonal availability. This journey showcases Mraz's dedication to sustainability and family-oriented farming.

title: 'Gods would be aghast': SC seeks faith-health balance in firecracker debate
content: The Supreme Court has reiterated the urgent need to tackle the health hazards posed by firecrackers. It underscored the vital role of community awareness in promoting environmentally friendly practices during festive celebrations. In its deliberations, the court questioned the religious relevance of firecracker usage, especially when weighed against the potential health risks.

title: FIR against Kejriwal, AAP leaders for 'chaos' at Bangla Sahib during CEC protest
content: DSGMC president Harmeet Singh Kalka, after filing the complaint, had said there was "great resentment within the Sikh community" over the alleged attempt by AAP workers to stage a protest near Gurudwara Bangla Sahib. He said the committee had taken action against those involved and lodged a police complaint against AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal.

title: Portugal makes U-turn on Ronaldo suspension, wants him back after Al-Nassr goal
content: Cristiano Ronaldo scored on his Al-Nassr return, taking his career tally to 980 goals, while Portugal have made clear they want their captain back. Despite the disciplinary proceedings following his camp exit, Ronaldo and coach Jorge Jesus have left the door open for a reunion. With November’s fixtures approaching, will Ronaldo return to Portugal after the fallout?

title: Congress Seva Dal seeks case against Bhaskar Rao over ‘fake news’ on Dhruv Rathee
content: In a representation dated October 10, Junaid P.K., president of the Brigade, alleged that Mr. Rao had created doubts about Mr. Rathee’s nationality by suggesting that he could be a foreign national.

title: Police to step up surveillance on airport stretch
content: The stretch covering areas including Athani Junction and Airport Junction has come under heightened surveillance following the car-two-wheeler collision that claimed the lives of three youths on October 11.

title: Delhi protests against CEC: What the law says about preventive detention | Explained
content: The Supreme Court directed the Union government and the Delhi Police to stop illegal detentions and allow free and smooth movement of people and traffic, as well as the operations of Metro and rail services, but “subject to law and public order”

title: INDIA bloc marches through Delhi, takes SIR protest to Supreme Court
content: Opposition presents a united front amid heavy police deployment but little interruption; Congress says 2.5 lakh people took part in the four-hour-long ‘March for Democracy’; most protesters Congress supporters who travelled from across the country

title: Constable carries woman’s body for a kilometre after retrieving it from river
content: The constable with Mantrayalam police found the body of a woman who allegedly ended her life in the Tungabhadra river floating in the waters, carried it on his back for nearly a kilometre through hilly terrain, before reaching the shore

title: Restrictions on firecrackers: Supreme Court urges balance between religious sentiments and public health
content: Justice Joymalya Bagchi questions religious basis for bursting firecrackers; CJI cautions against restrictions which cannot be enforced on the ground, says people should be educated to reject harmful cracker varieties

title: Over 3.85 lakh cases pending in 28 information commissions as of June 2026: report
content: The ‘Report Card on the Performance of Information Commissions in India, 2025-26’ says the number of appeals and complaints pending on June 30, 2026, in 28 information commissions stood at 3,85,716; in 2025, it was 4,13,972

title: Justice Nagarathna flags gaps in implementation of Juvenile Justice Act at National Annual Stakeholders Consultation
content: Justice Nagarathna said the focus should not be limited to disposing of cases. The system must also ensure that children receive education, counselling, medical care and legal assistance while their cases are pending.

title: Delhi Police mentally tortured me and my family, says CJP fouder Abhijeet Dipke
content: Modi will denotify democracy itself, he says after government denotifies Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site

title: Anti-CEC row updates: INDIA bloc leads march through Delhi, takes SIR protest to Supreme Court
content: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) co-convener Saurav Das on Monday (October 12, 2026) said the government’s decision to denotify Jantar Mantar as a protest site is “unacceptable”

title: Delhi Police de-notifies Jantar Mantar as protest site; activists slam decision
content: Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground named as alternative venues; police yet to issue SOPs for protests; activists say Jantar Mantar’s proximity to Parliament is crucial to making their voices heard

title: Rahul Gandhi likens Opposition protest to tandav, calls it ‘Shivji ki baraat’, where everyone is welcome
content: Congress leader claims the CEC has sent him messages, and over 200 officers in government provide information

title: Delhi police accused of beating, assaulting detainees, denying them basic rights
content: Detainees report being transported in ‘prison vans’, verbally and physically abused, denied water; one group taken to isolated police camp, seated in rows, and systematically beaten by police after their phones were confiscated

title: BJP hits out at Rahul Gandhi over “Shiv Ki Baraat” remark, alleges “anti-Hindu” sentiment
content: Shivraj Singh Chouhan says Congress leadership is directionless; Anurag Thakur accuses party of invoking religion for political ends

title: SIT examines ADGP Arun and other IPS officers in Veeramani case
content: The investigators recorded the statements of Mr. Arun and IGs N. Kannan and A. Radhika, who were then serving as the Additional Commissioner of Police, South, and the Additional Commissioner of Police, Central Crime Branch, respectively, police sources say

title: Extreme panic and fear, say Opposition, CJP at de-notification of Jantar Mantar as protest site
content: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh says ‘democracy no longer matters for the Home Minister and the Prime Minister’; CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke slams Modi govt. saying Jantar Mantar is ‘a spirit of resistance that nobody can ever take away’

title: Arlekar new full-time Governor of T.N., Sudha Yadav to take charge in Karnataka in new gubernatorial appointments
content: O.P. Mathur to now serve as Governor of Keralam; Braj Mohan Ram to be Governor of Odisha, Dhal Singh Bisen  Governor of Uttarakhand and former BJP general secretary Dushyant Gautam Governor of Sikkim

title: Opposition leaders move SC for full disclosure of SIR records, seek suspension of exercise
content: Leaders seek judicial examination of the Election Commission of India records to verify whether Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar acted arbitrarily and unilaterally during the ongoing SIR

title: LDF stages walkout from Keralam Assembly over police action at University Hostel
content: Speaker Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan disallowed its notice for an adjournment motion on the alleged attack by Youth Congress workers on the University Youth Hostel on September 30 and the subsequent police action

title: ANU under fire over contract faculty evaluating distance-education answer scripts
content: Allegations surface that the college has engaged contractual faculty members working at the postgraduate level at ANU instead of employing eligible degree-level teaching faculty to evaluate the answer scripts

title: Former security guard arrested for murder of five-year-old girl in Kowkoor over ₹20 lakh ransom
content: Residents of the gated community gathered at the Malkajgiri Police Commissioner’s camp office in Begumpet, raising concerns over children’s safety while parents are away at work.

title: DMK says no need for it to join Congress-led protests after exit from INDIA bloc
content: Reacting to Tamil Nadu Congress Committee president Manickam Tagore’s claim that the DMK had stayed away from protests demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar out of fear of the BJP, the DMK said he should question Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay’s absence from the agitation

title: 13.60 lakh names dropped from final electoral rolls after SIR in Punjab
content: The electorate increased from 1,93,94,435 in draft roll to 2,01,00,727 in the final roll, representing a net increase of 3.64%, says CEO

title: Northeast monsoon likely to set in over south peninsula in the net two to three days
content: Its arrival will coincide with the withdrawal of Southwest monsoon from the remaining parts of the country, says the Regional Meteorological Centre

title: Four including a toddler die after electric car hits wall and catches fire on Vijayawada West bypass
content: Three-year-old boy is among the deceased; victims were returning after attending a function when the accident occurred

title: Supreme Court wants cap on trade margin for all essential medicines and medical products
content: Government proposes 30% trade-margin cap on patented and non-patented cancer medicines, but top court asks why a margin cap cannot be extended to all medicines and medical products; the court says the government has to ensure that DPCO-approved medicines, whose price is legally regulated, reach patients

title: Kannur Corporation introduces double-decker bus for sightseeing during Dasara
content: Organised through the Kannur Corporation and KSRTC’s Budget Tourism Cell, the service will operate for 10 days, allowing residents and tourists to enjoy colourful illuminations and festival decorations in the city. Its continuation will depend on public response.

title: Billboard with Goddess Durga beside pot of biryani sparks row in Hooghly
content: Earlier, another row erupted when a religious outfit circulated a poster in Siliguri, urging people to buy biryani only from Hindu shopkeepers

title: MPSC paper leak case: Mumbai Crime Branch arrests another accused
content: The case relates to the alleged leak of the question paper for the MPSC Drug Inspector (Group B) recruitment examination held in March 2026

title: Detained In Assam, 12 Bangladeshis Claim They Were Promised Work In India
content: One of the detainees, Sirajul Islam, claimed that a broker from Bangladesh named Sabuj lured them with the promise of work in Assam. He brought them to India by crossing the border through a forest on October 6.

title: Kerala Congress Sacks Worker, Takes Down 'Chief Justice' Post After BJP Jibe
content: "Congress wants to destroy all the constitutional and democratic institutions of India. All Anti-India gangs are joining hands. All patriotic Indians will also come together," Kire Rijiju posted on X

title: Protests Nearly Doubled In A Decade. What Data Tells About Rise In Violence
content: From NEET and job-related protests to demonstrations over women's safety and the Election Commission, 2026 has seen protests over a range of issues.

title: 14 'Defects' In Rahul Gandhi's Petition, Rs 220 Shortfall Flagged By Supreme Court
content: A joint petition filed by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and several opposition leaders against alleged electoral irregularities and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls has 14 "errors", the Supreme Court said, including a shortfall of Rs 220 in court fees.

title: 4 Dead, 1 Injured As EV Catches Fire After Hitting Divider In Andhra
content: The car was completely gutted in the fire, and all four occupants died at the scene, while another person sustained serious injuries and is in critical condition.

title: Delhi SIR: 20 Lakh Cases Resolved After 33 Lakh Voters Get Notices
content: Special camps are also being held where the booth-level officers (BLOs) assist the voters. Such camps will be held to deal with SIR cases on October 18 and October 25.

title: "Almost Certainly": UK PM Says Iran Guards Behind Airbase Scare
content: The United States abruptly withdrew all its B-1 bombers from Royal Air Force Fairford last week after the mysterious incident at the base on September 27

title: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, 3 Other States Get New Governors
content: Om Prakash Mathur, Governor of Sikkim, will be the new Governor of Kerala in place of Arlekar, a communique issued by the Rashtrapati Bhavan said.

title: Maharashtra Man Takes Lover On Date To Waterfall, Then Pushes Her Into It
content: The victim's body was eventually recovered from a depth of approximately 1,000 feet, following which it was sent for post-mortem examination at the CPR Hospital in Kolhapur.

title: Bangla Sahib Row: Police Case Aganst Arvind Kejriwal, AAP Goes To Akal Takht
content: AAP legislators from Punjab approached the Akal Takht Sahib on Monday, seeking action over the alleged entry of Delhi Police personnel wearing shoes and without covering their heads.

title: 4 Pakistani Terrorists Killed In PoK Blast During Infiltration Attempt
content: The powerful explosion caused by an improvised explosive device (IED) rocked a forward village along the Line of Control (LoC) in the Krishna Ghati sector of Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district on Monday.

title: On Run For 3 Years, Madhya Pradesh Mass Shooting Accused Caught In Gurugram
content: The 37-year-old accused, identified as Ramusingh Dhirasingh Tomar, was traced to a warehouse in the Gopalpur GIDC area of Gurugram, Haryana. Police said he had been evading arrest for over three years by frequently changing identities.

title: 'Soft Target': Sacked JNU Professor Denies Sexual Harassment Charge
content: The MP, who worked as a professor at the prestigious university in Delhi, was sacked last week after at least eleven women accused him of sexual harassment, and an internal committee found him guilty on nine counts.

title: Meet Jannat Bishnoi, Young Face Beside Rahul Gandhi At Supreme Court March
content: Bishnoi is an Executive Councillor of the Delhi University Students' Union (DUSU). She is also a member of the National Students' Union of India (NSUI), the youth wing of the Congress.

title: "We Want Long-Term Peace": Kremlin Rejects Ukraine's 60-Day Ceasefire Offer
content: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters on Monday that Russia wanted a long-term peace deal rather than a temporary ceasefire.

title: Booth Level Officers To Revisit Homes Of Voters Excluded During Bengal SIR
content: This special drive aims to identify voters excluded during the SIR and assist them in updating their status in the current electoral roll.

title: Will PMK Join Tamil Nadu's Ruling Aliance? What Vijay's Minister Said
content: "If PMK comes into the TVK alliance, we will walk out. The ministerial post is less important to me than Thol Thirumavalavan and the VCK," Vanni Arasu said at a party meeting in Tindivanam on Sunday, reiterating that his party would not be part of an alliance that includes the PMK or the BJP.

title: 13.6 Lakh Names Deleted During SIR. Punjab Now Has 2 Crore Voters
content: The final list, released on Monday, records a decline of more than 13.6 lakh voters, or 6.33 per cent, from the 2,14,61,043 electors registered before the revision began.

title: Kolkata Cops Summon Abhishek Banerjee On Wednesday In Billboard Case
content: This morning, Abhishek Banerjee sent an email to the police, informing them that he had been busy with work and seeking 48 hours to appear before them.

title: SIR Stay, Action Against Officials: Rahul Gandhi's 10 Requests To Top Court
content: While Rahul Gandhi reached the Supreme Court in the evening, an hour or two earlier, the Congress legal team filed a petition at the top court, demanding ten forms of relief regarding the SIR and other decisions taken by the Election Commission.

content: a small portion of the ground, with space for around 150 people, remains available for protests and gatherings free of charge . the larger grasse, which spans 12 acres and can accommodate up to 50,000 people, is already booked for most of the next two-and-a-half months . it involves a daily fee and a refundable security deposit .

content: IRGC almost certainly directed a security incident at RAF Fairford, a British air base used by US bombers to strike Iran . dozens of nearby residents were evacuated and police investigated vans linked to the suspects . the UK government summoned the Iranian ambassador to protest .

title: President Murmu appoints new governors for 6 states; 4 new, 2 moved
content: the gubernatorial leadership will change in all six states . Keralam will have Mathur as its new governor, while Tamil Nadu will have Arlekar . the appointments include changes in Odisha, Karnataka and Uttarakhand .
